 05/Dated: 15.02.2024
 1.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. The present criminal revision has been filed against the judgment dated 25.08.2023 passed by the court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-I-cum-Special Children's Court, Koderma, in Criminal Appeal (Spl. Children's Court) No. 4 of 2023 whereby and whereunder prayer for bail of the petitioner has been rejected by confirming the order dated 02.08.2023 passed by the Juvenile Justice Board, Koderma in connection with Koderma SC/ST P.S. Case No.01 of 2022 registered under Section 341, 354, 376(1), 379 & 506 of the Indian Penal Code, under Sections 4/12 of the POCSO Act and under Sections 3(1)(r), 3(1)(s), 3(1)(w) of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act .

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The case is now pending before the Juvenile Justice Board, Koderma.
3. The petitioner, just below the age of 18 years at the time of commission of crime, and who is in custody since 28.02.2022, has approached this Court for his release on bail.

It has been submitted that now the petitioner has attained the age of majority, but his father has filed an affidavit showing that he is ready and willing to keep the petitioner under his proper care and custody.
It has been submitted that the trial is unnecessarily delaying the matter as the witnesses are not turning up.
4. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.

5. Perused the Social Investigation Report of the petitioner.
6.

Considering the Social Investigation Report, the petitioner is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the Shahil Singh @ Shahil Kumar Singh @ Sahil ... vs State Of Jharkhand ... ...

subject to the condition that one of the bailors must be the father of the petitioner.
7. Further, the concerned Probation Officer is directed to report once in a month to the learned trial court regarding the upkeeping of the petitioner.
8. The learned trial court is at liberty to take the petitioner in custody, if anything adverse is reported against the petitioner.
9. Accordingly, the present criminal revision stands allowed.
